nodes.label: photosynthesis

nodes.label: natural selection

nodes.label: homeostasis

nodes.label: apoptosis

nodes.label: symbiosis

nodes.label: gene expression

nodes.label: immune memory

nodes.label: metamorphosis

nodes.label: circadian rhythm

nodes.label: horizontal gene transfer
nodes.definition: The movement of genetic material between organisms other than by descent from a parent.

nodes.label: entropy
nodes.definition: A measure of the number of microscopic arrangements consistent with a system's macroscopic state.

nodes.label: phase transition
nodes.definition: An abrupt change in the bulk properties of a substance as a control parameter crosses a critical value.

nodes.label: resonance
nodes.definition: The large response of a system driven at a frequency matching its natural oscillation.

nodes.label: conservation of energy
nodes.definition: The principle that the total energy of an isolated system does not change over time.

nodes.label: quantum entanglement
nodes.definition: A correlation between particles such that the state of one cannot be described independently of the other.

nodes.label: symmetry breaking
nodes.definition: When a system's stable state has less symmetry than the laws that govern it.

nodes.label: critical mass
nodes.definition: The minimum amount of material needed for a self-sustaining chain reaction.

nodes.label: diffusion
nodes.definition: The net movement of particles from regions of high concentration to low concentration.

nodes.label: hysteresis
nodes.definition: When a system's current state depends on the history of inputs, not only their present value.

nodes.label: event horizon
nodes.definition: The boundary beyond which no information can escape to an outside observer.

nodes.label: catalysis

nodes.label: chemical equilibrium

nodes.label: polymerisation

nodes.label: solubility

nodes.label: chirality
nodes.definition: The property of a structure that is not superimposable on its mirror image.

nodes.label: activation energy

nodes.label: recursion
nodes.definition: Defining something in terms of smaller instances of itself.

nodes.label: isomorphism
nodes.definition: A structure-preserving correspondence showing two systems are the same in every relevant respect.

nodes.label: fixed point
nodes.definition: A value left unchanged by a transformation applied to it.

nodes.label: topology
nodes.definition: The study of properties preserved under continuous deformation such as stretching but not tearing.

nodes.label: combinatorial explosion
nodes.definition: The rapid growth in the number of possibilities as the size of a problem increases.

nodes.label: duality
nodes.definition: A correspondence in which every statement in one system has a mirror statement in another.

nodes.label: invariant
nodes.definition: A quantity that stays the same while a system undergoes change.

nodes.label: gradient descent
nodes.definition: Iteratively moving in the direction that most steeply reduces an objective function.

nodes.label: phase space
nodes.definition: An abstract space in which every possible state of a system is a single point.

nodes.label: incompleteness

nodes.label: regression to the mean

nodes.label: overfitting

nodes.label: base rate neglect

nodes.label: confounding variable
nodes.definition: An unmeasured factor that influences both the supposed cause and the supposed effect.

nodes.label: bayesian inference
nodes.definition: Updating the probability of a hypothesis as new evidence arrives.

nodes.label: sampling bias

nodes.label: signal to noise ratio
nodes.definition: The strength of a meaningful signal relative to the background variation obscuring it.

nodes.label: caching

nodes.label: garbage collection

nodes.label: abstraction layer

nodes.label: race condition

nodes.label: technical debt

nodes.label: load balancing

nodes.label: backpropagation

nodes.label: consensus protocol

nodes.label: idempotence

nodes.label: combinatorial search

nodes.label: compression

nodes.label: version control

nodes.label: opportunity cost

nodes.label: moral hazard

nodes.label: tragedy of the commons

nodes.label: monetary policy

nodes.label: comparative advantage

nodes.label: network effect

nodes.label: creative destruction

nodes.label: information asymmetry

nodes.label: liquidity

nodes.label: principal agent problem

nodes.label: inflation

nodes.label: cognitive dissonance

nodes.label: working memory

nodes.label: operant conditioning

nodes.label: confirmation bias

nodes.label: flow state

nodes.label: learned helplessness

nodes.label: priming

nodes.label: theory of mind

nodes.label: habituation

nodes.label: attachment

nodes.label: emergence

nodes.label: the ship of theseus

nodes.label: categorical imperative

nodes.label: qualia

nodes.label: reductionism

nodes.label: teleology

nodes.label: social contract

nodes.label: sorites paradox

nodes.label: instrumental convergence

nodes.label: metaphor

nodes.label: code switching

nodes.label: semantic drift

nodes.label: grammatical case

nodes.label: pragmatics

nodes.label: creolisation

nodes.label: phoneme

nodes.label: untranslatability

nodes.label: counterpoint

nodes.label: syncopation

nodes.label: timbre

nodes.label: modulation

nodes.label: improvisation

nodes.label: leitmotif

nodes.label: dissonance

nodes.label: polyrhythm

nodes.label: load bearing wall

nodes.label: desire path

nodes.label: modularity

nodes.label: negative space

nodes.label: vernacular architecture

nodes.label: cantilever

nodes.label: affordance

nodes.label: precedent

nodes.label: burden of proof

nodes.label: due process

nodes.label: jurisdiction

nodes.label: statute of limitations

nodes.label: fiduciary duty

nodes.label: differential diagnosis

nodes.label: chronic inflammation

nodes.label: resilience

nodes.label: invasive species

nodes.label: control system

nodes.label: planned obsolescence

nodes.label: ritual
